institution: University of Colorado Board of Regents

hero.tagline: Denver · Constitutional Higher Education Governance for CU Boulder, CU Denver, UCCS & Anschutz
hero.desc: The University of Colorado Board of Regents is the constitutional governing body of the University of Colorado System, overseeing four premier campuses: the flagship University of Colorado Boulder, the University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus, the University of Colorado Denver, and the University of Colorado Colorado Springs (UCCS). Managing an annual budget of $5.9 billion and generating $1.5 billion in sponsored research, the Regents lead the nation in aerospace, quantum physics, and biomedical therapeutics.
